notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked by an opponent.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Blacksmith's Talent is level three.
description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Blacksmith Talent's second ability triggers, attaching Sword of Hearth and Home to Fear of MIssing Out.
Declare Fear of Missing Out as an attacker.
Fear of Missing Out triggers, untapping a creature and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Fear of Missing Out.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, blinking Fear of Missing Out and searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Fear of Missing Out enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to rummage.
Repeat each combat phase.
